passages.excerpt_preview: he foundation inscription refers to construction of the stone temple of Raja Rajesvara by the emperor Rajaraja Chola in his 25th regnal year, 1010 A.D., at Tanjore.
The gifts include gold diadems, plates, bowls, pitchers, chains, trumpets, parasols and fly whisks.

passages.locator: gifts made by him, his sister, his queens
passages.excerpt_preview: It records the royal order to be engraved on the base of the main temple and the gifts made by him, his sister, his queens and others.
